# TaxAct

> TaxAct is a comprehensive online tax filing platform offering DIY, expert-assisted, and full-service tax preparation for individuals and businesses.

TaxAct provides flexible tax filing solutions ranging from free federal filing to premium tiers supporting complex returns with investments, rental income, and business entities. The platform serves individual filers, self-employed professionals, business owners, and tax professionals with over 25 years of experience in tax preparation.

## Key Topics

- Online tax filing
- DIY tax preparation
- Self-employed taxes
- Business tax filing
- Form 1040
- Schedule C
- W-2 filing
- Tax refund
- E-filing
- Expert tax assistance
- CPA and EA support
- Tax credits
- Investment income
- Federal and state taxes
- Tax software

- [Deluxe Online Tax Filing](https://www.taxact.com/taxes-online/file-your-own-taxes/deluxe-tax-filing): TaxAct Deluxe tier with homeowner deductions and HSA support
